subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline keys only, or by adding an OpenClaw-owned configurable send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies newline insertion through pi-tui, but the remaining configurable behavior would create a new public TUI config or CLI contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests and docs.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's built-in newline support as sufficient and explicitly decline docs/help or configurability as part of this issue.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history owner for the TUI editor, docs/help, and prior issue review direction.
